name: Hardal
description: Query and analyze your Hardal first-party data directly in Claude. Explore server-side attribution, conversions, campaigns, sessions, events, product and e-commerce performance. With Hardal as persistent context, Claude can reason about your first-party measurement alongside your code, documents, and decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hardal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hardal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.usehardal.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hardal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hardal provides these MCP tools: get_analytics_event_counts, get_analytics_overview, and get_top_campaigns.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hardal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hardal in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Hardal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hardal is developed by Hardal. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
